fmrilatent

Source: AGENTS.md

Purpose

R package for latent space representations of fMRI neuroimaging data. Provides S4 classes (LatentNeuroVec) for memory-efficient storage and manipulation of dimensionality-reduced brain data using matrix factorization (basis x loadings). Integrates with the neuroim2 package for standard neuroimaging data structures.

The core idea: represent 4D fMRI data as X = B * L' + c where B is a temporal basis, L is spatial loadings, and c is a voxel-wise offset. This enables efficient PCA, ICA, wavelet, Slepian, HRBF, and other decompositions.

Architecture Overview

Core Class Hierarchy

neuroim2::NeuroVec
  └── neuroim2::AbstractSparseNeuroVec
        └── LatentNeuroVec  (basis + loadings + offset + map + meta)

Subsystem Map

Subsystem Files Description
Core Class all_class.R, latent_neurovector.R, latent_methods.R, latent_indexing.R LatentNeuroVec S4 class, constructor, [, [[, series, show
Generics all_generic.R S4 generics: basis, loadings, offset, map, mask, lift, encode
Handle System latent_handles.R, latent_neurovec_materialize.R BasisHandle/LoadingsHandle for lazy materialization with an LRU-bounded registry cache (fmrilatent.registry.max_entries, default 256) and fingerprint-checked reuse
Encode Pipeline encode.R Spec constructors (spec_time_*, spec_space_*, spec_st) and encode() dispatch
Reduction reduction.R GraphReduction, ClusterReduction, CoarsenedReduction + lift()
Haar Wavelets haar_wavelet.R, zzz_haar_aliases.R Morton-ordered Haar lifting transform (R + Rcpp)
Heat Wavelets heat_wavelet.R, heat_wavelet_handle.R Heat-kernel graph wavelets on parcels
Diffusion Wavelets diffusion_wavelet.R, diffusion_wavelet_handle.R Diffusion wavelet bases
Active Wavelets wavelet_active.R CDF 5/3 pencil wavelet on mask-active voxels
Slepian/DPSS slepian_temporal.R, slepian_spatial.R, slepian_spatiotemporal.R, slepian_handles.R Discrete prolate spheroidal sequences (temporal, spatial, spatiotemporal)
HRBF hrbf.R Hierarchical radial basis functions (multi-scale spatial atoms)
DCT/B-spline dct_basis.R, bspline_basis.R Deterministic temporal bases
Hierarchical hierarchical_template.R, hierarchical_helpers.R Multi-scale parcel templates (Schaefer atlas)
Utilities searchlight_utils.R, spatial_plot.R, slepian_plot.R, graph_bridge.R, benchmark_roundtrip.R Searchlights, plotting, graph helpers, benchmarking
Implicit Latent implicit_latent.R ImplicitLatent — closure-based reconstruction without stored basis

For AI Agents

Working In This Directory

  • Always run Rscript -e "devtools::load_all()" after modifying R source files
  • Run Rscript -e "devtools::document()" after changing roxygen2 comments (regenerates man/ and NAMESPACE)
  • Collation order in DESCRIPTION matters — latent_handles.R must load before all_class.R
  • 2-space indent, snake_case for functions/objects
  • S4 methods use setMethod("generic", "Class", ...) pattern
  • roxygen2 comments for user-facing functions; use @keywords internal for private helpers
  • Keep files ASCII; prefer pure functions; avoid side effects or hidden globals

Testing Requirements

  • Run Rscript -e "devtools::test()" before committing
  • Full check: Rscript -e "devtools::check()"
  • Tests use testthat edition 3: tests/testthat/test-*.R
  • Use set.seed() for reproducible random data in tests

Common Patterns

  • Handle pattern: BasisHandle/LoadingsHandle defer materialization — basis(x) calls materialize_basis() only when needed
  • Spec pattern: spec_time_*() / spec_space_*() create lightweight descriptors; encode_spec() dispatches to builders
  • Lift pattern: lift(reduction, spec) computes bases on coarsened graphs, lifts to ambient space
  • Registry: Shared cache for materialized dictionaries, controlled by options(fmrilatent.registry.enabled = TRUE/FALSE)

Dependencies

Internal (neuroim2 ecosystem)

  • neuroim2 — Core neuroimaging types: NeuroVec, NeuroSpace, LogicalNeuroVol, IndexLookupVol
  • neurosurf — Surface-based neuroimaging (optional, used in some spatial methods)
  • neuroatlas — Atlas data (optional, used for Schaefer parcellations)
  • rgsp — Graph signal processing (optional, used in Slepian/graph methods)

External

  • Matrix — Sparse/dense matrix classes (dgCMatrix, dgeMatrix)
  • Rcpp / RcppEigen — C++ interop for performance-critical code
  • methods — S4 class/generic/method infrastructure
  • crayon — Colored terminal output for show() methods
  • digest — Hashing for handle IDs

Rscript -e "devtools::document()"      # Regenerate docs
Rscript -e "devtools::check()"         # Full R CMD check

Issue Tracking with Mote

This project uses mote for local issue tracking, path reservations, notes, handoffs, and agent coordination. Do not use beads (bd) in this repo. Mote issue IDs may still have bd-... prefixes; use those IDs only with mote commands.

Essential Commands

Command Purpose
mote doctor Validate the local mote store
mote actor show Confirm the current actor identity
mote ready List tasks without blockers
mote new "Title" -p 1 --tag <area> Create a task
mote show <id> View issue details and history
mote preflight --issue <id> --paths <path> ... Check reservation conflicts before editing
mote begin <id> --paths <path> ... --note "starting" Claim work and reserve paths
mote note <id> --kind progress "..." Record progress, decisions, or blockers
mote done <id> --note "finished" Mark completed work done
mote handoff <id> --to <actor> --note "..." --release Hand off unfinished work
mote release <id> Release a claim when stopping without completion
mote board Inspect active work and reservations
mote who-has <path> Find the actor reserving a path
mote inbox Check direct coordination messages

Critical Rules for Agents

  1. Do not run bd commands; mote is the tracker for this project.
  2. Reserve before editing with mote preflight and mote begin.
  3. If mote preflight or mote begin reports a conflict, inspect with mote who-has <path> and coordinate before editing.
  4. Record meaningful state changes with mote note.
  5. Never hand-edit .mote/ops/*.json; publish tracker changes through mote.

Multi-Agent Coordination

Use mote as the primary coordination channel for local agents. Reservations are advisory but must be respected.

  • Reserve before editing: mote preflight --issue <id> --paths <path> ... followed by mote begin <id> --paths <path> ...
  • Release when done or stopping: mote done <id>, mote handoff <id> ... --release, or mote release <id>
  • Check inbox: mote inbox
  • Send direct messages: mote msg send --to <actor> --issue <id> --kind request "..."

Commit & PR Guidelines

  • Commits: imperative, concise (e.g., “Add HRBF basis generator”, “Wire HRBF to LatentNeuroVec”)
  • PRs: describe scope, note tests run, call out performance implications
  • Link issues when available

Landing the Plane (Session Completion)

When ending a work session, complete ALL steps:

  1. File issues for remaining work (mote new "Title" -p 1 --tag <area>)
  2. Run quality gates (devtools::test(), devtools::check())
  3. Update issue status (mote done, mote note, or mote handoff)
  4. Release claims/reservations (mote release or handoff with --release)
  5. Push committed code with git push
  6. Provide handoff context for next session

Work is NOT complete until git push succeeds.
